title: Order
description: An order exported from the SpotOn Restaurant POS System.

deleted.description: Whether the order is marked as deleted.

orderTypeName.description: Order type name at the time of assignment.

createdByEmployeeId.description: Identifier of the employee who created the order.

createdByEmployeeName.description: Name of the employee who created the order.

closedAt.description: RFC 3339 closure timestamp. Null if the order is open.

orderNumber.description: Assigned order number. Empty if unassigned.

tableNumber.description: Assigned table number. Empty if none.

scheduled.description: Whether the order is scheduled for the future.

releasedAt.description: RFC 3339 kitchen release time for scheduled orders.

ownerInfo.description: Employee ownership details for an order.

jobPositionId.description: Job position identifier held during ownership.

totalAmount.description: Final total after discounts, taxes, and surcharges, as a decimal string.

balanceDueAmount.description: Remaining balance due, as a decimal string.

items.description: A check on an order, holding guests, payments, and surcharges.

gratuityAmount.description: Applied auto-gratuity amount, as a decimal string.

totalAmount.description: Final check total, as a decimal string.

paymentsAmount.description: Total payments received, as a decimal string.

balanceAmount.description: Remaining balance, as a decimal string.

items.description: Items applied directly to the check, typically empty.

voidedItems.description: Voided items applied directly to the check.

updatedAt.description: RFC 3339 last update timestamp, including milliseconds.
